data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Hamann was believed to be the brother of Zeus, the supreme god. He was a powerful deity associated with hospitality, justice, and strength. Hamann was also revered for his protective nature and was believed to be a guardian of the home and hearth. The name Hamann carries the meaning “Brother of the high god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hamann usually hope their child will grow to embody brother of the high god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
